message: Qdrant sync completed. Canonical Concept DB rows are mirrored to vector DB.

architecture_rating.scope: Concept DB MySQL to Qdrant mirror alignment
architecture_rating.meaning: This API runs only after canonical Concept DB commit. It mirrors eligible concepts into Qdrant and updates concepts.has_vector only after success.

quality_gate.reason: Concept DB MySQL rows were mirrored to Qdrant successfully.

recommended_actions: If using existing 1536d Qdrant collection, set EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small and EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=1536.
If using text-embedding-3-large, set QDRANT_CONCEPTS_COLLECTION=concepts_3072 so a new 3072d collection is created.
